description: The pie chart, captioned "Ever-scalingness," illustrates the concept of ever-scalingness through four distinct components. The chart consists of four equal slices, each representing approximately 25% of the total area. The top-left slice is colored yellow-orange and contains the inner text "Complexity" alongside a ladder icon, with an adjacent outer label box reading "Uncrushable." The top-right slice is blue, featuring the inner text "Instance" with a shield and checkmark icon, and is paired with an outer label box reading "Unhackable." The bottom-left slice is red, displaying the inner text "Scalable Oversight" with a document and magnifying glass icon, accompanied by an outer label box reading "Auto-verifiable." The bottom-right slice is green, showing the inner text "Coverage" with a globe icon, and has an outer label box reading "General." The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit percentage labels inside the slices. Visually, the four segments are slightly offset from one another by white gaps, creating a separated appearance, and they are not ordered by size as all proportions are visually equal.
